title: Postero-lateral MI: Fully Evolved | Health Education Assets Library (HEAL)
description: The true posterior MI is recognized by pathologic R waves in leads V1-2.  These are the posterior equivalent of pathologic Q waves (seen from the perspective of the anterior leads). Tall T waves in these same leads are the posterior equivalent of inverted T waves in this fully evolved MI. The loss of forces in V6, I, aVL suggest a lateral wall extension of this MI.
